275-5078-8346.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Type-03 Borg Vessel.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2034-2317-6664-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

4694-4802-7306-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-7306-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

391-783-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-783-2645-3430.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1796-2701-7182-7252.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Centaur Omenreader
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

529-3197-5223-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3384-4067-4343-7802.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a card in hand.
3384-4067-4343-7802.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Hylda triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw two cards due to Thought Reflection.
Seven of Nine triggers, causing you to draw two cards due to Thought Reflection.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
3384-4067-4343-7802.notes: You can skip step 5 if an opponent controls an untapped creature.

6823-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6823-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
6823-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

2034-3129-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-3129-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2713-3094-3480-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-3480-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

3101-3292-3892-7297.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3892-7297.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3892-7297.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

1169-3259-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

140-997-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-997-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-997-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-997-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-5295-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2393-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

536-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control except Riptide Laboratory can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
536-2493-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Riptide Laboratory's second ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Archaeomancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3525-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Scholar of the Ages

813-1409-6103-6492.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scholar of the Ages by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Scholar of the Ages.
Repeat each turn.

1887-2583-5870-5874.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

803-1429-4779-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-4779-5402.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

372-1987-2239.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Ardent Elementalist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
372-1987-2239.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-1603--39.notablePrerequisites: Evil Twin is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-1603--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Evil Twin trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

81-2060-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-4048-4050-4300.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eight lands, five of which enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {5}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
1401-4048-4050-4300.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Activate Meloku five times by paying {5} and returning the five lands from the battlefield to your hand, creating five 1/1 Illusion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Illusions, adding {2}{G}{G}.
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Whirlwind of Thought triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting at least five lands from your hand onto the battlefield, then causing you to discard a card and Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
Repeat.

379-3865-4013-4440-5311.manaNeeded: {1}{B} on your first turn, with {3}{C}{B} available each extra turn
379-3865-4013-4440-5311.notablePrerequisites:
Varragoth does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Varragoth.
379-3865-4013-4440-5311.description:
Declare Varragoth as an attacker.
Activate Varragoth by paying {1}{B}, searching your library for Draco, then shuffling your library and putting Draco on top of it.
During the next upkeep, Timesifter triggers, exiling Draco and causing you to get an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Riftsweeper.
Riftsweeper enters the battlefield, shuffling Draco from exile into your library.
Repeat.

1146-1371-3948-4398.description:
Cast Eternal Dominion.
Eternal Dominion is exiled with Eye of the Storm.
Choose to not cast your copy of Eternal Dominion with Eye of the Storm.
Hive Mind triggers, and all other players are forced to cast Eternal Dominion.
All other players may not cast any other spells for the rest of the game because of Eternal Dominion's Epic ability, and they can not use Enduring Ideal due to Stranglehold.

1309-3557-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Brago can not be blocked.
1309-3557-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

225-1584-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-1584-4222.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Teferi's Isle.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
